### Implementation

So I have the Hamiltonian of the Hénon–Heiles potential

$$H(x,y,p_x,p_y)=\frac{(p_x^2+p_y^2)}{2m} + \frac{m\omega^2}{2}(x^2+y^2)+\alpha(x^2y-\frac{y^3}{3}).$$

We obtain the equations of motion by


::: {.columns}

::: {.column}
$$\dot{q_i} =\frac{\partial H}{\partial p_i} $$ 


:::

::: {.column}

$$\dot{p_i} =-\frac{\partial H}{\partial q_i} $$

:::

:::

for canonical conjugate variables $(p_i,q_i)$ labeled by $i\in\mathbb{N}$.

The resulting equation of motion in julia code:
```{markdown}
function equations!(du, u, p, t)
    m = 1
    a = 1
    w = 1
    x, y, px, py = u
    du[1] =  px/m
    du[2] =  py/m
    du[3] = -m*w^2*x - 2a*x*y
    du[4] = -m*w^2*y - a*(x^2 + y^2)
end
```
